node: Compound-semiconductor epitaxy tools for lasers and optical connectivity
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the US-listed universe around compound-semiconductor epitaxy tools tied to AI optical connectivity. The cleanest US-listed direct equipment candidate found is Veeco, which sells MOCVD, MBE, ion beam, wet-processing, etch/clean and other tools used in compound semiconductor and photonics manufacturing. AXT is an adjacent materials/substrate candidate because InP/GaAs substrates sit immediately upstream of laser epitaxy. Onto Innovation is an adjacent metrology/process-control candidate for compound semiconductor and photonics yield control. Lumentum is included as a high-attention reference/customer anchor because its orders for Aixtron G10-AsP MOCVD systems validate AI-related InP laser capacity expansion. Aixtron itself is a critical non-US primary reference name for this node but is not included as a candidate because the requested universe is US-listed.
